'''Teekwo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He made his living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] for the [[Contraband Resale Corporation]] on board [[Carrick Station]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Teekwo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a expansion produced by [[BioWare]] for their [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
